headline: PICK RUSH: clock in, sort the line
lede: A new original arcade game on the forge: a gantry crane at a night-shift conveyor. Dip the claw, drop every piece in its tagged bin, beat the shift clock — and mind the glass.

notes.text: PICK RUSH shipped (#1142, PR #1193): four shifts, five bins, combo pay, three fuses. Barrels roll and slip; bottles shatter unless you feather them down with DOWN.
Head-to-head is real: the FOREMAN CPU takes every other piece by spawn and banks within ~10% of a clean run — P opens seat 2 for a human on one keyboard.
pickcheck: 36 gates (25 Node rules + determinism + win proof, 11 browser pixel-vs-sim proofs after real keystrokes); all four planted mutants die on named checks.
The contract pattern flailed our own crane into three wrong-bin fuses at tick 419 — harness pads now wander gently; real-rule coverage lives in the game's own check.
